description: This file implements the HealthcheckServiceFactory class, which creates instances of IHealthcheckService with a specified healthcheck interval. It includes methods for constructing the factory and creating healthcheck service objects, referencing external classes such as HealthcheckService and ITimer.

classes.name: HealthcheckServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating healthcheck service instances with a specified interval.

methods.name: HealthcheckServiceFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with a healthcheck interval.

methods.name: createHealthcheckService
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of IHealthcheckService, configured with the provided app manager and the factory's healthcheck interval.
